description: This file contains React component tests for the 'Notes App' using @testing-library/react and Jest, including mock setup for localStorage and various UI behavior tests.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up mock return value for localStorage.getItem and clears setItem mock before each test.

methods.name: test('renders app header')
methods.description: Verifies that the app header element is rendered.

methods.name: test('renders create note form')
methods.description: Checks for presence of 'Title:' and 'Content:' input labels.

methods.name: test('renders action buttons')
methods.description: Checks that 'Generate Summary' and 'Save Note' buttons are rendered.

methods.name: test('title input accepts text')
methods.description: Simulates user input into title field and verifies value update.

methods.name: test('content textarea accepts text')
methods.description: Simulates user input into content textarea and verifies value update.

methods.name: test('save button is disabled when fields are empty')
methods.description: Ensures the save button is disabled when input fields are empty.

methods.name: test('save button is enabled when fields are filled')
methods.description: Fills in input fields and checks that the save button is enabled.

methods.name: test('displays empty state message when no notes')
methods.description: Verifies that message indicating no notes are saved appears.
